rules.text:
Rules

1. The stage (the patch's ControlPanel, now 960×540 = 16:9, drawn 1:1) is never covered by panels. Whatever needs room docks beside or below it, and the stage scales down uniformly (animated). Only two small shell controls sit on it: the notch and the view switch.
2. Top bar: patches + patch name (with reload), ScriptFX, chat, settings. No Macros button, no Controls sheet.
3. The notch is back, slimmer: one row of snapshot controls (‹ Init › · save · load), hanging from the top bar.
4. Surface / Chain / Matrix: three icon buttons floating in the stage's top-right corner (label on hover).
5. The mod dock below the stage is always there: macros (paged 1–8 / 9–16) and the five modulators, each with a live mini display.
6. Knobs show only small route dots. Selecting a source in the dock shows that source's rings + meta knobs on every knob (Serum's rule); everything else dims. Clicking it again opens its editor: the dock grows, the stage shrinks.
7. Window 984×708 (was 836×640 with an 840×560 panel at 97 %): wider, not taller. The dock gets its own 108 px; its chevron collapses it to a 32 px strip (button + a dot per modulator) and the window shrinks to 984×632.
8. Every source has a title bar in its colour (name + ≡ grip): the drag handle. Grab it: the bar lifts off as a tag tied to its tile by a thin cable; knobs that can take it get a dashed outline in its colour, the one under the tag turns solid and previews the range; on release the tag drops in and a meta knob is left. Circles stay reserved for knobs and meta knobs.
